title: Apexspace factory feature
description: A charcoal half-and-half band: on the left a big light uppercase title, a small square icon at the gutter with indented paragraphs beside it and a yellow mono button; on the right a photo filling the whole half from top to bottom, bleeding off the edge. On phones the text comes first and a square photo runs full-bleed at the bottom.
notes: media fills the right half like object-fit: cover (square on phones); empty shows a muted placeholder
